content.title: The Hoist and the Wager
content.theme: A keep whose two landings are joined by one cage on a chain.
content.premise: The `lift` fixture with a recovery stake standing in the same room, which is the shape the economy worker filed as an open finding (#355): a teleport moves ENTITIES, so the ground under a stake marker is untouched and what travels is the marker itself, away from the position the collecting player's ledger recorded. `stk_gc_<s>` then finds nobody holding a wager at the marker's new position and retires it, taking the wager with it. No compile-time geometry test can state this — a marker's position is chosen at RUNTIME — so the proof is a class the marker declares and every box-narrowed selector excludes (`DW0544`, `compiler::affordance`), plus the PackTest this campaign generates for it.
